title: For Stan Rice
text: For Stan Rice 1942-2002 -the love of my life. Epigraph Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes; but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee to judgment. Ecclesiastes 11:9. King James Version
